subject: System Design
title: The Toyota Unintended Acceleration
description: A quick, practical guide to The Toyota Unintended Acceleration.

hook.text: Toyotas accelerated on their own, causing crashes and deaths. Investigators found code with 10,000 global variables.

buildup.text: The engine control software was a tangled mess of spaghetti code that had grown over decades.

discovery.text: NASA's review found the code had no fail-safe for a stack overflow that could disable the throttle watchdog.

twist.text: Toyota blamed floor mats. It took external investigators to prove the software was fundamentally unsafe.

climax.text: Toyota paid $1.2 billion in fines. Uncontrolled technical debt in safety-critical code had lethal consequences.

punchline.text: 10,000 global variables in code that controls your throttle.

quiz.question: What did NASA find in Toyota's engine control software?
options: Spaghetti code with 10,000 global variables and no stack overflow protection
